statement_summary: Group CISO accountable; Carrier CPNI officer and CALEA senior officer per operating company; Tower lighting owner
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level; 911, lighting, and lawful-intercept High risks must be treated
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document common control inheritance annually; tenant agreements on shared platforms
Sanctions expressly cover CPNI misuse
No agreement no data for vendors and affiliates; 24-hour incident notice; FAR flowdown
Annual common control assessment and division samples
Retention of security documentation and regulatory records
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Regulatory certifications backed by an evidence pack the signer reviews
Unique identities; no shared accounts on any system including network elements and gateways
Role-based least privilege; purpose-approved affiliate access to CPNI; no standing cross-tenant access
MFA for all; phishing-resistant for IT, network, and NOC administrators
Network elements administered through central AAA with named accounts and MFA from jump hosts
Access disabled within 4 hours of termination; vendor leavers same business day
Quarterly certification including privileged, service, and tenant roles
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM
Remote access into group or customer networks only through brokered recorded sessions; no persistent tunnels
Customer authentication for CPNI in every channel including AI; change notices
No default passwords on devices; certificates where supported
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
One group severity scale and playbooks
Service-impact gate before containment; Part 4 and FAA steps start at once
Record discovery and the CPNI reasonable determination; do not wait for forensics
CPNI law enforcement notice within 7 business days; no customer or public disclosure during the hold
Notification matrix owned by the Group General Counsel; quarterly review
Severity 1 to disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K within 4 business days or the Item 1.05(d) delay
Lawful-intercept compromise escalated to the CALEA senior officer and reported to law enforcement
Engineering customer notices within contract terms
Annual cross-division exercise with matrix, service-impact gate, and materiality
Classes defined; CPNI, call detail, lawful-intercept data, landowner data, configurations, and route maps are Restricted
Encrypt Restricted and Confidential information at rest and in transit
CPNI use only for permitted purposes or with approval; affiliate disclosure only under agreement; campaign register
Lawful-intercept information only on SYS-C8 by authorized employees
FCI only in the SYS-E2 enclave
Immutable separate-provider backups; offline copy of network configurations
Sanitize media with a certificate
Retention schedule; CDRs online at most 24 months; light outage records 2 years
No Restricted data in AI tools without approval and no-training terms
Annual awareness including pretexting; quarterly phishing
Role-based CPNI training before access, including outsourced and affiliate staff
Approved generative AI tools only
Record calls only with the notice or consent state law requires
No call detail by telephone without the password
Network element configuration backups with an offline copy in a second region
CALEA SSI policy per operating company; quarterly appendix check; refile within 90 days of a merger
Chatbot release gate for authentication and account actions
MNO remote access through brokered PAM sessions; no persistent tunnels
Covered equipment screening; reporting within 1 business day (52.204-25) or 3 business days (52.204-23)
Visitor logs and escorts at project offices
Written fallback to daily observation when lighting monitoring is lost
RMU inventory and quarterly inspection tracking
No default RMU passwords; private APN or certificates
